items: A short tour of Amaviro's less obvious features, with its own Apple TV version. Open it any time from About Amaviro.
A refresh button at the top of Now and Sports, with a tick when it's done. Pulling down still works.
Now's header keeps the full date and time.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
